description: NaPS₃ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/m space group. Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six S atoms. There are a spread of Na-S bond distances ranging from 2.90-3.32 Å. There are two inequivalent P sites. In the first P site, P is bonded to four S atoms to form edge-sharing PS₄ tetrahedra. There are two shorter (2.00 Å) and two longer (2.14 Å) P-S bond lengths. In the second P site, P is bonded to four S atoms to form edge-sharing PS₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of P-S bond distances ranging from 1.98-2.18 Å. There are five inequivalent S sites. In the first S site, S is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na and two P atoms. In the second S site, S is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na and one P atom. In the third S site, S is bonded to four equivalent Na and one P atom to form distorted edge-sharing SNa₄P square pyramids. In the fourth S site, S is bonded in a trigonal non-coplanar geometry to two equivalent Na and one P atom. In the fifth S site, S is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na and one P atom.
